VRSN_2007_p138__paragraph_5.ocr:
On September 1, 2007, the Company sold its wholly-owned Jamba Service GmbH subsidiary (“Jamba
Service”), which marketed insurance and extended service warranties to consumers for mobile electronic
equipment and products, for $12.8 million in cash and recorded a net gain of $1.4 million. Jamba Service was
considered a discontinued operation and was part of the Communications Services Group segment.
